current_suggestion.pitch: Mauboussin is a serious investor and researcher who sits at the intersection of mental models, decision science, and base-rate thinking — covering exactly the Kahneman/Munger territory you care about but with rigorous application to real forecasting and probabilistic reasoning. His content steelmans the 'outside view' and reference class forecasting in ways that complement your current diet of Lex/Huberman/Attia epistemics without the self-help veneer. Format is a mix of lecture-style solo content and structured interviews, typically 30–60 minutes with genuine analytical depth.
